name: 91104 · Pasadena, CA
findings: ZIP 91104 (Pasadena) has 219 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91104 (Pasadena) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91104 (Pasadena) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
